import pandas as pd

def find_expensive_cities(listings: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    overall_avg = listings['price'].mean()
    grouped = listings.groupby('city')['price'].mean().reset_index()
    res = grouped[grouped['price'] > overall_avg][['city']].sort_values(by='city')
    return res
